create_staged_logger: create a StagedLogger instance with a tag and minimum sample count for metric aggregation
add_metrics_to_logger: add metrics data with a global step to the StagedLogger for aggregation across workers
finalize_metrics: finalize and retrieve aggregated metrics from the StagedLogger counters as a dictionary
reset_logger_state: reset the StagedLogger internal counters and state to begin a new aggregation stage
close_staged_logger: close the StagedLogger and its underlying remote metric logger connection
